candidate_name: Peru National LNG Regasification Plant (Proinversión APP tender)
sponsor_or_proposer: Government of Peru — Ministry of Energy and Mines (MINEM) / ProInversión (public-private partnership tender; no private sponsor selected yet)
current_state: Announcement of intent only. Triggered by the March 2026 Camisea gas-supply emergency (pipeline rupture/deflagration, 14-day national emergency declared 2026-03-02). On 2026-03-16 Energy Minister Angelo Alfaro stated the government will task ProInversión with launching a tender (convocatoria) to build an LNG import/regasification plant, projected operational in ~2 years. As of mid-2026 this is an intent statement, not an executed tender, FEED, site selection, or contract award.
missing_threshold_elements: Location (no city/port/region specified — historical precedent was a ~130,000 m3 storage terminal 'south of Lima', but no site is currently designated); Concrete step (tender not yet launched as of the 2026-03-16 announcement — verbal/policy intent only, the §3 'minister said the country will build a terminal' edge case); Private sponsor (APP awardee TBD — only the state proposer is identified).
watch_for: ProInversión formally launching the convocatoria / publishing tender terms; a designated coastal site (likely south of Lima, possibly Callao/Pampa Melchorita area); an awarded concessionaire or FSRU charter; any FEED or environmental pre-filing. Any of these would move this from monitor to a stageable new_terminal (import, proposed). Re-check Q4 2026 / Q1 2027 (Proinversión's stated gas-portfolio window is 2026-2027).
notes: URL-verified (PASS on 'regasificadora'+'Proinversión'). Corroborated by El Comercio (https://elcomercio.pe/economia/peru/minem-gobierno-encargara-a-proinversion-convocatoria-para-licitar-proyecto-de-planta-de-regasificacion-de-gnl-l-ultimas-noticia/ — also URL-verified). This is a coastal LNG IMPORT regasification terminal (imports LNG by ship, regasifies, feeds the pipeline grid) — distinct and in-scope, NOT the inland 'masificación' gas-by-truck satellite-regas distribution program (Cálidda adendas, Arequipa/Moquegua/Tacna, Puno) which is out-of-scope small-scale distribution. Genuinely NEW to GEM (GEM's two Peru terminals are both export: Peru LNG operating, Ilo shelved). Held below threshold pending a concrete step + a designated site.
